name: ニーマン・ピック病C型

summary.text: A rare lysosomal lipid storage disease characterized by variable clinical signs, depending on the age of onset, such as prolonged unexplained neonatal jaundice or cholestasis, isolated unexplained splenomegaly, and progressive, often severe neurological symptoms such as cognitive decline, cerebellar ataxia, vertical supranuclear gaze palsy (VSPG), dysarthria, dysphagia, dystonia, seizures, gelastic cataplexy, and psychiatric disorders.
summary.evidence: A rare lysosomal lipid storage disease c

symptoms.text: prolonged unexplained neonatal jaundice or cholestasis
